scope: Reconstruct precommitted R35B common input with separate component-fit/null/eval partitions, compare real upstream CPU implementations against identical registered arrays. This is cross-implementation development evidence, not externally blind validation.

freshness_audit.scope: R35B protocol inadvertently omitted these actual R32 groups. Report any overlap and fail prospective qualification, but permit labelled retrospective reproduction. No retuning.

calibration: All native score thresholds frozen at <=5% of the same two null target controls, not on evaluation; no calibration from R28B. Separate fit groups for JANUS component margins. No labels passed to native score functions.
timing: Native kernel, I/O, validation bridge, compile costs separately. Peak RSS process, CPU model and threads environment, no cross-run speed assertion absent compatible measurement. Realized control rates reported; no equal-FAP claim from calibration budget alone.
promotion: No production changes; compare per-patch paired losses, weak and very weak, all four injection classes, and 128 shared positives. Need held-out source-family data and independent external custody for scientific validation.
